Flow.description: This version is looking at the Order Line object, not the Invoice Line Object as we couldn't add a look up to the Parent Account ID to get the correct data. This flow is used at account level. If the customer has an "Overriding account discount %" then it will follow a different branch. It will find any active discount records and then find the associated price book entry. It will then find frequently ordered products (the number is limited to stop CPU limits).
Flow.label: View products Order Line Lookup
